'''January 2001 Nashville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Nashville, TN on 27 January 2001. [[Jim Sells]] won it. It is known from Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1687">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-finally-a-nashville-locald1687/ finally-a-nashville-local], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 29 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-finally-a-nashville-locald1687/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Nashville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Sells]]
